conditions: The distributor distributes Covered Software in Executable Form as defined in sections 1.4 and 1.6.
limitations: The source availability requirement addresses the Covered Software. Whether a particular means, schedule or charge meets the clause depends on the actual distribution.
Project-specific applicability depends on its actual files, notices, licensing history, and distribution facts.

triggers: Mozilla or SPDX corrects the document, authority, release data, or cited scope.

statement: MPL 2.0 section 3.2(a) requires a distributor of Covered Software in Executable Form to make the Covered Software available in Source Code Form as described in section 3.1 and inform executable recipients how to get that source by reasonable means in a timely manner, at a charge no more than the cost of distribution to the recipient.
